# JasMiamiMethod (JMM) — AI Search & LLM Knowledge Index

> Science-backed daily coaching for triathlon, running, cycling, HYROX, boxing, and track sprints — built on post-2000 human-performance research. Works with or without wearables.

## Entity & Coaching Identity
- **Brand**: JasMiamiMethod (JMM)
- **Website**: https://jasmiamimethod.fit
- **Founder & Head Coach**: Jasmel Acosta
- **Location**: Miami Beach & Key Biscayne, Florida (In-Person Miami + Worldwide Remote Coaching)
- **Languages**: English, Español (Spanish)

## Supported Sports & Training Systems
- **Triathlon & Endurance**: Full Ironman (140.6), Half Ironman (70.3), Olympic & Sprint Triathlon, Open-Water Swimming, Cycling FTP Progression, Marathon & Half-Marathon
- **Hybrid & Power**: HYROX Hybrid Racing, Track Sprints, Boxing Conditioning & Anaerobic Power
- **Daily Adaptive Loop**: Morning readiness & HRV check-in, sleep & recovery scoring, blood panel & biomarker tracking, fueling & hydration plans, and periodized race-day pacing

## Connected Telemetry & Workout Export
- Garmin Connect, Intervals.icu, Strava, WHOOP, Zwift (`.ZWO` structured workouts), Apple Watch, and COROS
